Physical camera trap device record.
Supports location-based grouping via site_id even when geographical
coordinates are unknown or withheld.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for the camera.
id.title: Id

site_id.description: Optional site or station identifier for hierarchical grouping.
site_id.title: Site Id

provenance.description: Origin tracking for supplied camera metadata.
provenance.title: Provenance

Camera.title: Camera

DataSourceMode.description:
Discriminates operational inference data from official dataset reference annotations.

Phase 2 extension. Never mix these modes in the same analytical computation.
- OPERATIONAL_PREDICTION: real model inference outputs from Harsh/Santosh pipeline.
- DATASET_REFERENCE: official human-annotated ground truth (e.g. Caltech Camera Traps).
DataSourceMode.title: DataSourceMode

DatasetReferenceAnnotation.description:
Official dataset annotation (e.g. from Caltech Camera Traps ground truth).

Phase 2 discriminated type for dataset_reference mode.
This entity MUST NOT be mixed with operational_prediction Detection records.
It preserves:
- Original source annotation ID and image ID.
- Original category ID and category name exactly as published.
- Namespace-prefixed internal identifiers to avoid collisions with operational IDs.
- Bounding box in dataset-native COCO pixel format (xmin, ymin, width, height).

Key distinctions from Detection:
- No prediction run, model name, or confidence score (none are available).
- No triage state (dataset annotations assert presence, not probability).
- No invented review events.

id.description: Namespaced internal identifier, e.g. 'cct:ann:12345'. Original source annotation ID is preserved in source_annotation_id.
id.title: Id

observation_id.description: Reference to the Observation record for the annotated image.
observation_id.title: Observation Id

source_annotation_id.description: Original annotation ID as published by the dataset.
source_annotation_id.title: Source Annotation Id

source_image_id.description: Original image ID from the dataset (before namespacing).
source_image_id.title: Source Image Id

dataset_version.description: Dataset version or release identifier if available.
dataset_version.title: Dataset Version

category_id.description: Original category ID exactly as published. Integer for CCT (COCO Camera Traps format).
category_id.title: Category Id

category_name.description: Original category name exactly as published (e.g. 'coyote', 'empty', 'person').
category_name.title: Category Name

wildscope_taxon_id.description: Mapped WILDSCOPE taxon identifier, if a canonical mapping exists. None if category is non-animal, empty, unknown, or unsupported. Mapping is documented in the dataset adapter.
wildscope_taxon_id.title: Wildscope Taxon Id

is_animal.description: True if category represents an animal species or group. False for 'empty', 'vehicle', 'person', and non-animal categories.
is_animal.title: Is Animal

bbox_coco.description: Bounding box in COCO pixel format [xmin, ymin, width, height]. Preserved exactly from the source dataset. Not normalized.
bbox_coco.title: Bbox Coco

sequence_id.description: Dataset burst sequence ID (seq_id in CCT format).
sequence_id.title: Sequence Id

provenance.description: Source dataset provenance (URL, license, import timestamp).
provenance.title: Provenance

DatasetReferenceAnnotation.title: DatasetReferenceAnnotation

Detection.description:
Object-level animal detection and classification output.
Distinguishes detection confidence from classification confidence,
and explicitly tracks triage status and uncertainty.

run_id.description: Reference to PredictionRun that generated this output.
run_id.title: Run Id

animal_detection_confidence.description: Confidence that an animal is present in the frame/crop [0.0, 1.0].
animal_detection_confidence.title: Animal Detection Confidence

predicted_taxon_id.description: Canonical taxon identifier if species classification succeeded.
predicted_taxon_id.title: Predicted Taxon Id

raw_label.description: Original unmodified label emitted by the vision classifier.
raw_label.title: Raw Label

score_type.description: Output type of the classification score.

bbox.description: Normalized bounding box of detection in frame.

Encounter.description:
Operational grouping of observations within a camera trap temporal session.
Represents an encounter event; does NOT establish individual animal identity
or population size.

camera_id.description: Reference to Camera where encounter occurred.
camera_id.title: Camera Id

member_observation_ids.description: Observation IDs included in this encounter.
member_observation_ids.title: Member Observation Ids

member_detection_ids.description: Detection IDs included in this encounter.
member_detection_ids.title: Member Detection Ids

Encounter.title: Encounter

EncounterProcessingStatus.description:
Status of encounter grouping processing in the vision/clustering pipeline (Harsh).
Explicitly distinguishes whether encounter grouping is available, pending, completed, or failed.
EncounterProcessingStatus.title: EncounterProcessingStatus

MediaAsset.description: Source raw media file (image or video) stored in object/file storage.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for media asset.
id.title: Id

storage_key.description: Internal storage identifier or path key.

raw_timestamp.description: Unparsed raw timestamp string from EXIF or filename.

Explicit documented operational effort intervals for a camera.

Normalized bounding box.

(0, 0) is top-left, (1, 1) is bottom-right.
NormalizedBBox.title: NormalizedBBox

Observation.description:
An individual frame or standalone image observation event.
Links detections to source media and physical camera.

frame_offset_ms.description: Video frame offset in milliseconds (null for still photos).
frame_offset_ms.title: Frame Offset Ms

raw_timestamp.description: Raw EXIF timestamp string preserved for audit.

detection_ids.description: Ordered list of Detection IDs belonging to this observation.

PredictionRun.description:
Audit record of an inference model run.
Ensures complete traceability of model hashes, device, and settings.

model_version.description: Version identifier of vision model artifact.
model_version.title: Model Version

cache_hit.description: Whether output was served from cache.

PredictionRun.title: PredictionRun

PredictionStatus.description: Status of an inference execution run.
PredictionStatus.title: PredictionStatus

ReviewDecision.description:
Human review decision on a target detection or encounter.
Reviews are append-only audit events and do not mutate original model outputs.
ReviewDecision.title: ReviewDecision

ReviewEvent.description:
Human review decision.
Original model outputs remain immutable; reviews are append-only audit events.
The effective state is resolved transactionally by the backend.

Phase 2 extension:
- sequence_number: backend-assigned monotone integer ordering reviews on the same target.
  When supplied, the resolver uses this instead of created_at for deterministic ordering.
  Santosh must supply this when review_ordering_mechanism = "backend_revision".

target_id.description: Reference to target Detection ID (or Encounter ID).
target_id.title: Target Id

corrected_taxon_id.description: Required if decision is CORRECT_SPECIES, forbidden if REJECT_DETECTION.
corrected_taxon_id.title: Corrected Taxon Id

expected_revision.description: Source dataset revision at time of review (for optimistic concurrency).
expected_revision.title: Expected Revision

sequence_number.description: Phase 2: Backend-assigned monotone integer ordering ReviewEvents on the same target. When present, used as authoritative ordering; created_at is supplementary. expected_revision is a concurrency precondition, NOT an ordering mechanism.
sequence_number.title: Sequence Number

ReviewEvent.title: ReviewEvent

ReviewOrderingMechanism.description:
Documents how multiple ReviewEvents for the same target are ordered
when resolving the effective label.

Phase 2 requirement: Shravan's resolver must not guess ordering.
ReviewOrderingMechanism.title: ReviewOrderingMechanism

ScoreType.description:
Semantic nature of model prediction score.
Crucial for preventing mistaking raw logits or uncalibrated softmax scores
for true posterior probabilities.
ScoreType.title: ScoreType

dataset_revision.description: Transactional data revision counter identifying this data state.
dataset_revision.title: Dataset Revision

created_at.description: Timezone-aware timestamp when snapshot was assembled.

source_system.description: System or worker generating this snapshot.

has_spatial_context.description: Flag indicating whether spatial zones and layers are included.

has_monitoring_effort.description: Flag indicating whether verified camera active intervals are supplied.
has_monitoring_effort.title: Has Monitoring Effort

data_source_mode.description: Phase 2: discriminates operational model inference data from official dataset reference annotations. Analytics outputs are labelled accordingly.

review_ordering_mechanism.description: Phase 2: documents how multiple ReviewEvents for the same detection target are ordered when resolving effective labels. backend_revision requires Santosh to supply a per-event sequence_number field.

encounter_processing_status.description: Phase 3: status of encounter grouping processing (Harsh's group_encounters). When None (legacy 1.0.0/1.1.0 snapshot), conservative compatibility treats an empty encounters list as UNAVAILABLE.
